candidates.review_note: The defined OR-of-XOR product is not assumed associative, so ordinary matrix exponentiation would be invalid. Work independently per bit and per evolving row. An output bit at column j is zero exactly when the entire current row bit vector equals original column j; otherwise it is one. Group equal original columns by their exact integer bit vectors. One multiplication maps any row to the complement of one column-equivalence-class mask, or the all-one mask if no column matches. Hence after the first multiplication every row belongs to a closed set of at most n+1 states. Build its deterministic transition and binary-lift m-2 further applications, starting from the actual first row transition. Recombine the bit planes exactly. The specified left-associated recurrence, including m=1, is preserved.
